le-chatelier-stresses.alt: A table of changes made to a system at equilibrium, the direction of shift, and whether K changes. Add a reactant or remove a product: shift toward products, K unchanged. Add a product or remove a reactant: toward reactants, K unchanged. Decrease the volume of a gas mixture: toward fewer gas moles, K unchanged. Add an inert gas at constant volume: no shift. Add a catalyst: no shift. Raise the temperature of an endothermic reaction: toward products, and K rises. Raise the temperature of an exothermic reaction: toward reactants, and K falls.
